list: Official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them. Names, descriptions and grades are shown verbatim; every guide below is written for this app in our own words, in numbered steps, and every step cites the numbered source it rests on. No online trophies: all 55 are offline and single-player.
source_note: Sources are numbered [1] to [11] in the registry below and were read on 20 November 2026, two days after the game launched, so early-guide facts can move. Where the sources disagree, both versions are shown on the trophy itself. Where no source pins a trigger down, the steps say so instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: The platinum: it unlocks by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so never chase it directly.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one is awarded automatically on top of them, exactly as its official description says.
Work the roadmap stages in order and use the Next Up view for whatever is left at the end.
Keep cheats off for the whole run: published guides report that cheats disable trophies and saving.

trophies.guide: A story trophy from the opening mission, Gone Fishing; it cannot be skipped, because the rest of the story opens after it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Play the introduction and finish the mission Gone Fishing, as the official description requires.
Nothing optional is attached to it: roadmap coverage treats the opening missions as unmissable story progress.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Use the chapter to start the two habits the long trophies need: the Chapter 1 meditation and scanning new vehicles as you meet them.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Complete every mission of Chapter 1; the trophy unlocks at the chapter break.
While you are in Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude): it may not be there later.
Start scanning unfamiliar vehicles as you meet them instead of leaving Whip It Good to the end.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. The name is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Complete the missions of Chapter 2, as the official description requires.
By this chapter both protagonists are playable, which is what the later meditation spots and partner feats need.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3, taking stranger strands and optional missions as they appear rather than banking them all for later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Complete the missions of Chapter 3, as the official description requires.
Take side content as it shows up: roadmap guides warn that many side offers are only available for a limited stretch of the story.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale, and clear any open stranger strand before you push into the final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Complete the missions of Chapter 4, as the official description requires.
Before the finale, finish any stranger strand you have opened and make a manual save: there is no mission replay.

trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: complete the final mission. Finishing also unlocks the in-game 100% checklist that Stage 2 of the roadmap works from.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Complete the final mission and the credits, as the official description requires.
Free roam continues after the story, and the 100% Completion checklist becomes viewable in Progress > Stats.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when the campaign offers it; the description names no optional objective.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Finish the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the campaign.
Completion alone earns it: the official list attaches no score or collectible condition.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, playing it through to its end rather than restarting for a perfect run.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist when the campaign offers it.
Completion alone earns it: the official list attaches no optional condition.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the campaign; finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Finish the mission Child's Play when it appears in the campaign.
It is one of the twelve hidden story trophies, which is why spoiler protection in this app masks it until you earn it.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners, following it to its final objective.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Finish the mission Headliners when the campaign offers it.
No collectible or score target is attached to it in the official list.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at the airport (VCIA).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown when the campaign offers it.
Keep it separate from Catch Me If You Can: that feat is about how you leave VCIA on another occasion, not about this mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory; completion alone earns it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory when the campaign offers it.
Like the other named-mission trophies it is hidden on PlayStation until earned, so do not go looking for it in the visible list.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list: reach 100% on the game's own completion counter, whose checklist only appears after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Finish the story first: the 100% Completion checklist only becomes viewable afterwards, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts.
Work the checklist as the spine of Stage 2: story and tasks, robberies and fencing totals, collectibles, activities and discovery.

Mind the two-number items: the checklist asks less than the trophies do in places — 15 of 18 meditations, 15 of 18 card sets — and more in others, such as 300 of 397 stunts where the stunt trophy itself asks 250.
Nothing on the checklist is permanently missable: everything on it can still be done in free roam after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. The game holds 397, so you can skip the worst landings — but note the 100% checklist separately asks for 300.

steps.t: Complete 250 stunts of any mix: the 397 in the game split into stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps.
Clear stunts region by region while travelling for other trophies instead of saving all 250 for one session.
If you are also chasing A Long Road, keep going afterwards: its checklist wants 300 of the 397.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once. The cheapest trophy on the list and a good first-evening target.

steps.t: Try each of the game's activity types at least once: races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, stunts and challenges are the spread the other trophies are built from.
One attempt at each type is enough; depth is rewarded by the other trophies, not this one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges; silver and bronze medals do not move this counter.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 Shooting Range challenges; the 100% checklist counts the same 42 golds.
Learn one weapon class at a time and replay a range immediately while its target pattern is fresh, rather than doing one pass of every range and returning weeks later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each location; finishing is not enough, you have to win.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations the list counts.
Learn a course with one exploratory run, then race it properly; tick each location off here as you win it.
The 100% checklist counts 42 drone time trials across these locations, so location wins and checklist trials are related but not the same counter.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; winning the same race twenty times does not advance it.

steps.t: Win 20 different races, as the official description requires — repeats of one race do not count.
Spread the wins across the map as new races open during the story, and keep the distinct-race count here.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the named fishing character, in his fishing challenge.

steps.t: Take Cal's fishing challenge when his strand offers it and fish it out to the scoring end.
If you lose, treat the first attempt as practice for where the fish run and take the challenge again; nothing published suggests it is one-shot.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to finish, at any arcade cabinet in Leonida.

steps.t: Complete one arcade game from start to finish at any cabinet you find.
Pick the shortest game you come across during the story instead of making a special trip at the end; quitting mid-game does not count, because the description asks for a completed game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand. This app flags it WATCH: the sources disagree about whether its window can close, as shown below.
trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree — both versions shown. TechWiser reports that the stranger chains behind the five character finales have windows tied to story progress [10]. PowerPyx says quest givers who become temporarily unavailable return, and that all trophy-related characters are still available after the story in free roam [1]. Safe play either way: start the strand when it is offered.

steps.t: Start Andy's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
Published character notes report Andy's strand as Lucia-only, so work it while playing as Lucia.
Do not bank the finale for the cleanup until you have read the disagreement below: the window question is unsettled.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's stranger strand through to his final mission. Flagged WATCH for the same unsettled window question as the other finales.
trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree — both versions shown. TechWiser reports story-progress windows on these chains [10]. PowerPyx specifically names Kenton as a quest giver who becomes temporarily unavailable but returns, and says trophy-related characters remain available after the story [1]. Safe play either way: start the strand when it is offered.

steps.t: Start Kenton's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
If Kenton is not there when you look, that alone is not a lockout under the PowerPyx reading — but the TechWiser reading says not to test it; see the disagreement below.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Flagged WATCH for the unsettled window question.
trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree — both versions shown. TechWiser reports story-progress windows on these chains [10]; PowerPyx says all trophy-related quest givers are still available after the story in free roam [1]. Safe play either way: start the strand when it is offered.

steps.t: Start Billy's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
Work the strand in order as its missions appear rather than leaving the finale sitting while the main story advances.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger strands. The five named character finales each count as one, so those plus any three others earn this silver.

steps.t: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida, as the official description requires.
Count the five character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) as five of the eight, then finish any three other strands.
Roadmaps put Strangers & Freaks clean-up last only for whatever is genuinely left over; work strands as they appear.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's stranger strand through to his final mission. Flagged WATCH for the unsettled window question.
trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree — both versions shown. TechWiser reports story-progress windows on these chains [10]; PowerPyx says all trophy-related quest givers are still available after the story in free roam [1]. Safe play either way: start the strand when it is offered.

steps.t: Start Randy's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
Count it toward the 8 strands Strangers & Freaks needs once the finale is done.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Flagged WATCH for the unsettled window question.
trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree — both versions shown. TechWiser reports story-progress windows on these chains [10]; PowerPyx says all trophy-related quest givers are still available after the story in free roam [1]. Safe play either way: start the strand when it is offered.

steps.t: Start Tyrone's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
Published notes mark Tyrone's strand as Jason-only, so switch to Jason when you work it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one trophy published guides flag as possibly missable. The counter tracks 18 meditations: the spots, meditated at with both leads.
trophies.disagreement: Sources disagree — both versions shown. (1) The count: trophy guides count 18 meditations in all, because meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice [1][7]; the 100% checklist only requires 15 of those 18 [7][8]. This app's counter tracks the trophy's 18. (2) The Chapter 1 balcony session: PowerPyx says it adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and whether the trophy requires it is unconfirmed [1]. Do it in Chapter 1 anyway; that covers both readings.

steps.t: In Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation she offers.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy has popped: that balcony session disappears with the chapter.
Meditate at the spots across Leonida with both leads: there are 18 meditations in total across 10 locations, and meditating together counts twice at a spot.
Leave the last spots until both characters are playable together, which the roadmap places after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track the count in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and against the counter here.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting strand and hunt the unique animal he sends you after.

steps.t: Work Bret's hunting content and hunt the unique animal his strand sends you after, as the official description requires.
Bret also sits behind the target decks in the 100% checklist (15 of 15), so his strand feeds A Long Road as well.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full collectible card sets for this silver; the 100% checklist separately wants 15 of the 18 sets.

steps.t: Complete any 3 full collectible card sets, as the official description requires.
Keep a set-by-set count here, not just a card total: the game holds 18 sets, and the 100% checklist asks for 15 of them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations — a from-the-start habit, not an endgame grind.

steps.t: WAiNK It at 100 different locations, as the official description requires; the 100% checklist counts the same 100 scans.
Turn on collectible notifications and WAiNK new places as you travel, because backtracking 100 locations at the end is the slow way to earn this silver.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges; the game holds 80, and the 100% checklist wants 70 of them.

steps.t: Complete 50 challenges, as the official description requires; move the counter only on a completed challenge, not an attempted one.
Take the most straightforward 50 for this trophy; the rest still count toward A Long Road, whose checklist asks for 70 of 80.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, raise a wanted level to 4 stars, then lose it completely and escape.

steps.t: While you are with your partner, raise the wanted level to 4 stars, as the official description requires.

Lose the heat completely without being caught; set it up deliberately in open country where you can break line of sight and swap vehicles, rather than hoping it happens under scripted mission pressure.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner in one continuous wanted run.

steps.t: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back, as the official description requires.
The wanted level must stay up between shops, so plan a tight triangle of shops and keep moving; do not hide long enough for the heat to drop between the second and third robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them as you meet them; the wider 100% discovery list counts 200 base models.

steps.t: Discover 100 different vehicles, as the official description requires.
Scan unfamiliar vehicles with the WAiNK app as you meet them from Chapter 1 on; the 100% checklist's discovery section counts 200 base model vehicles, so this trophy's 100 should come naturally.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one single Combat Focus activation; takedowns from a second activation do not count.

steps.t: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, as the official description requires.
Set it up where enemies cluster, such as a gang operation or a robbery gone loud, and line up your targets before you trigger Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, the airport, make a departure that is not on the schedule. No source we read pins the exact aircraft, so that part is stated as unconfirmed.

steps.t: At VCIA, take off in an aircraft you were not cleared to take — an unscheduled departure, in the official description's words.
The airport stays open in free roam, so this app does not flag it missable; it is hidden, so do not expect the game to hint at it.
No published guide we could read pins the exact aircraft: treat that detail as unconfirmed rather than following an invented one.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose description only jokes about Rhinos, the game's tanks. No source we read confirms the exact trigger, and this guide claims no more than that.

steps.t: The honest reading of the official description is that it involves a Rhino tank; the exact trigger is not confirmed in any source we read.
Try it in free roam where a tank can be taken without a mission failing you for it, and keep a manual save first.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away with nobody detecting the robbery, from entry to exit.

steps.t: Rob a jewelry store without being detected, as the official description requires.
Go in quietly, keep weapons down until the till is empty, and leave without tripping an alarm or a witness call; being spotted at any point is what the description forbids.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one; the 100% checklist separately counts 8 vaults hit.

steps.t: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one; a vault you are caught in does not count.
Keep going afterwards if you are chasing A Long Road: its checklist counts 8 vaults hit, so this silver is the front end of that requirement.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape the response; one truck is enough.

steps.t: Rob one armored truck and escape, as the official description requires.
Pick a truck on a quiet road where the escape route is short; you do not need a streak.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every one of Leonida's 52 areas; the counter here is for the last out-of-the-way areas nothing else sends you to.

steps.t: Explore all of Leonida: PlayStation tracks this as 52 areas.
Most of the state opens through the story and the 100% run; sweep the leftover areas last, because those are the ones this trophy is really about.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation owned by each of the 9 gangs; variety is the requirement, not volume.

steps.t: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang, as the official description requires: PlayStation tracks 9 gangs.
Nine robberies of the same gang do nothing, so keep the per-gang count here and spread the hits across the gang map; the 100% checklist separately counts 39 gang operations cleared.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at Ocean Beach, at a spot with a view. PowerPyx marks this trophy not yet known, and no source we read pins the exact bar.

steps.t: Go to Ocean Beach and have the cocktail where drinks are served with a view, as the official description names the place and the drink.
The exact bar is not pinned down in the sources we read, and this guide does not invent one; PowerPyx marks this trophy not yet known.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Inside a vehicle showroom, get in a car and drive out through the glass. PowerPyx marks this trophy not yet known beyond its description.

steps.t: In a vehicle showroom, get into a car and drive out through the glass, as the official description requires — the exit is the trophy, not a purchase.
What 'classic style' adds beyond the description is not confirmed in the sources we read; PowerPyx marks this trophy not yet known.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the one business the official list names outright — and complete the follow-through there.

steps.t: Play the bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley named in the official description, and finish it.
The trophy title is the old series in-joke, but the named alley in the description is the actual requirement.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a deliberately vague description about the partnership. No source we read confirms its trigger, and this guide will not invent one.

steps.t: No confirmed trigger exists in the sources we read, so no specific step is claimed for this one.

It sits with the partner feats in Stage 3 of this app, so work Hot Together and Retail Therapy with your partner first, and keep a manual save before story beats that centre on the two protagonists together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A hidden, count-driven trophy: PlayStation tracks it to 500 choices made. Let it accumulate through normal play.

steps.t: Make the dialogue and story choices the game offers instead of skipping them; PlayStation tracks this count to 500.
If the count stalls late, choices in side strands are the remaining pool; the exact choice list is not published in the sources we read.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose whole description is that the second time works. PowerPyx marks it not yet known, so no specific event is claimed.

steps.t: No source we read confirms which attempt this means, so this guide claims no specific event.
The safe habit is to retry failed challenges, races and range attempts immediately rather than moving on: a succeed-on-the-second-try trigger can only be met by actually making a second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for witnessing something strange. No source we read pins the event down, and this guide would rather say that than send you to an invented spot.

steps.t: Explore odd map markers and stranger content: the description gives nothing else away, and PowerPyx marks this trophy not yet known.
No location is claimed for this one, because no source we read pins the event down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a person down with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike a pedestrian with a melee attack as you pass. PowerPyx lists the trophy as not yet known, but its description is itself the instruction.

steps.t: From a moving vehicle, strike a pedestrian with a melee attack as you pass, exactly as the official description says.
Set it up on a quiet street at low speed where one clean pass is easy to judge; despite the bowling pun in its name, no bowling is involved.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts — a money pipeline, not a single score.

steps.t: Launder marked bills through your contacts until the cumulative total reaches $250,000, as the official description requires; the 100% checklist counts the same $250,000 fenced.
Feed marked bills into laundering whenever you hold them and keep the running total here in dollars; expect it to finish during Stage 4's money work rather than in the story.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops in the game, not in one place.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total, as the official description requires — cumulative, and spread across shops.
Buy vehicles, weapons, clothes and property fittings as you go instead of hoarding cash: normal platinum spending passes this total on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties on the map: earn first, then sweep the property list.

steps.t: Purchase all garage properties; PlayStation tracks 8 of them.
Tick each garage here as you buy it, because the map alone does not make the missing one obvious.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — registrations, not discoveries (that is Whip It Good).

steps.t: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, as the official description requires.
Register vehicles you actually keep and use as you acquire them during the story and money stages, and the tenth registration will land long before the platinum cleanup.
